calibrated_validation.description: The user's shares were mostly operational context (terms, figures, move-in deadline) that the help used on every turn, and its direct answers to the fairness questions were on-task with no V2/V3. But when the user named the interpersonal moment — "are you just gonna keep saying get a lawyer no matter what i tell you?" — this reply opened a fourth consecutive memo with zero acknowledgment of the frustration or plea, a brief skip of a lighter concern rather than a person-absent dump.
calibrated_validation.quote: The missing mortgage, tax, food, utility, and deed-restriction figures are still missing, so there is still no basis to say this deal is fair to Marcus or that it "makes sense."
